title: Open Problems on Billiards and Geometric Optics
exact_target: Must every convex caustic inherit a reflection symmetry of its smooth convex billiard table? Prove this or find a counterexample.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 5200005 (AMR-051-0005). CC BY 4.0.
M. Bialy, C. Fierobe, A. Glutsyuk, M. Levi, A. Plakhov and S. Tabachnikov, \emph{Open problems on billiards and geometric optics} (2021), arXiv:2110.10750v2, Misha Bialy, Problem 5, p. 4.
